description: This file contains unit tests for the AsyncExecutorWithRetries utility class in Orleans, focusing on retry logic, success filters, and error handling in asynchronous operations.

classes.name: Async_AsyncExecutorWithRetriesTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the AsyncExecutorWithRetries utility in Orleans, covering retry mechanisms, success filters, and error handling.

methods.name: Async_AsyncExecutorWithRetriesTest_1
methods.description: Tests that the retry mechanism correctly retries a failing function until success or max retries are reached.

methods.name: Async_AsyncExecutorWithRetriesTest_2
methods.description: Verifies that the success filter correctly stops retries when a success condition is met.

methods.name: Async_AsyncExecutorWithRetriesTest_4
methods.description: Ensures that when the function succeeds immediately, the error filter is not invoked and retries are not performed.

methods.name: Async_AsyncExecutorWithRetriesTest_5
methods.description: Tests the behavior of the error filter when it returns true, false, or throws an exception, affecting retry logic.
